subject: As to the calculation of the mean, median and variance Shiny.

messages.author: 26bcb67da090c65f
messages.subject: As to the calculation of the mean, median and variance Shiny.
parts: I would like to know how to calculate these three variables, considering that the data should be entered from the keyboard. Thank you.

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: As to the calculation of the mean, median and variance Shiny.
parts: You can have a text box so that the user enters their numbers. Then, you should have a button which runs code that splits the input into a vector of numbers and initiates the calculation. Your interface would have three text outputs, where you would print the results.
